customerDefaults: User confirmed Youngnam flower material exact customer names only: box transport 1500, loading 2000. Manual edits override including zero/empty (save validator still rejects invalid). All other customers retain evidence prices. No master price or ERP writes on preview.
combinedTransport: Carnation 01+02 combines into one 01 final-value row. Existing 01 freight retains its shipment date and changes to the final total, not an increment. Existing 02 freight blocks combination. Missing or ambiguous dates block. Other freight stays separate; cumulative boxes exclude unchecked rows.

actions.name: FREIGHT_PREVIEW_READ_ONLY
actions.presentation: Same-customer selected-year recent eight parent weeks supply freight evidence, with explicit Youngnam defaults. Customer-approved carnation 01+02 combination is selectable, targeting a verified 01 date; other freight remains separate. Top sticky submit and per-group cumulative boxes. Existing additional-item ledger write policies preserved.
actions.guard: 1920x1080 compact 3-column country/variety color groups and selected box subtotals. Hide repeated source-row date/week visually only, preserve original identity and registration scope. EXE detail mapper preserves date quantity/unit conversion. Unknown quantities are explicitly counted beside known subtotal. No SQL writes or changes to existing save flow.

actions.guard: Delegates to estimate-freight-atomic contract. Existing positive orders preserved; missing orders created positive. Receipt and all rows commit atomically. Former freight direct write endpoint remains 410. No category-wide unfix/fix.
